title: Welcome to Lampy Paperwork V31
paragraphs: Lampy Paperwork is a browser-based workspace for creating and managing the technical paperwork used on live entertainment productions. It brings fixture patching, power calculations, distro and Fan Out documentation, control systems, network devices, rack layouts, exports, and project records together in one place.
The app is designed to keep related project information connected, reduce repeated data entry, and produce clear paperwork that can move with a production from planning through delivery.

V31 adds a customisable Home dashboard, project and browser layout preferences, a full-page Positions workspace, global position updates across project devices and fixtures, and role-first console ordering within each position.

Lampy Paperwork is still under active development. Features, layouts, workflows, and saved data may continue to change while the app is tested and improved. Download and keep regular copies of your Lampy project file.
